title: Progress Software to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on September 30, 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Progress Software Corporation's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
BURLINGTON, Mass., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Progress Software](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=33vIFc2GHWfVCemosDRiqNWWlRTvRFE4N4hzUVshGyCAJuSbsrWNUHLZtgoOzyc4I6KSarbMcKbSR2YLFAmxKhM2JEfR3t9tPZO0K7AFZi0=) (Nasdaq: PRGS), a member of the Russell 2000 Index and an AI infrastructure software leader, today announced that it will release financial results for its fiscal third quarter of 2026 after the market close on Wednesday, September 30, 2026. Progress will host a conference call to review and discuss the results at 5:00 p.m. ET the same day. The company’s third quarter of fiscal year 2026 ended on August 31, 2026.


**Conference Call Details**
A live webcast of the call will be available using[this link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gCbKcQr60Uknt__KGC13IacxXLygBJoQqCniIGZjV1ITlqObbkKSdLNisFhP6UgaGblqbXIL3KVpjSlz-vVzkIGYCvecuNWgeXSBI-hnMurYxRxSS97HrU-jWVB2e-gn) .


To access the conference call by phone, please use[this link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gCbKcQr60Uknt__KGC13IWCjekngdOu-rmlZ3yKgFrYeiZ0qOT3PlnDDhppBFHlyKXUyz_cHKe1wWJoujvQLrk1TgOlwOqD_f75yNbtaMNnv-i-dsmnWjcMyxO01upAKnW4qth3NAnrDcndczIG75bVR8LFwHIfSCGKdOhzB4jw=) to retrieve dial-in details. To avoid delays, we encourage participants to dial into the conference call 15 minutes ahead of the scheduled start time.


An archived version of the conference call and supporting materials will be available on the[Progress Investor Relations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=33vIFc2GHWfVCemosDRiqI-V4LBQYNWxxLxMLSHaX4L2QYAeLeQoHWcItmwY8Syciadt17LUeUtd8XcMxPT5zoOUBvnUX7NsxF0zGITUjWPX4wgxvCKtxmyaQ-o1MAzx) webpage after the live conference call.


**About Progress Software**
Progress Software (Nasdaq: PRGS) provides the context and control organizations need to reliably extract value from AI— ***context*** drawn from an organization's data, content and workflows, and ***control*** over the security, governance and cost of their AI initiatives. Learn how hundreds of thousands of businesses, powering the work of tens of millions of professionals worldwide, realize value from trusted, enterprise-ready AI at[www.progress.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nd9ER3yXXygITK-nn3mEqYvNEX56AGOvq1QbP9aLGgnfw-bs64l9CWRXKrlSEg5dXErSjagM6sTwmJ-VWWmhfY4ZVg0006tNbOfVF_WL3XU=) .
